simplifications.decision: Reuse and port existing guided cases by name; preserve counts instead of adding duplicate end-to-end flows.
simplifications.tradeoff: Explicit count/name reconciliation and final source binding are required.

simplifications.decision: Reuse existing fresh-install and migration suites for seven-area re-baseline.
simplifications.tradeoff: DDL constraints and entity parity need direct review; no production upgrade compatibility is claimed.

simplifications.decision: Run one root-owned backend baseline and independent runner baseline concurrently; serialize later Gradle gates.
simplifications.tradeoff: Implementation waits until frozen baseline capture finishes.

simplifications.decision: Keep one existing generator and one byte-identity check rather than a second contract-generation framework.
simplifications.tradeoff: Full public-document pin and generated output identity become the central checks.
